contentText:
Ella Langley is officially the longest running No.1 on the Hot 100 with “Choosin’ Texas,” while Karol G reaches a new high on the chart with her song “BbY WOW,” while Taylor Swift, Stella Lefty, Olivia Dean and Ariana Grande continue to remain in the top 10.

Tetris Kelly: History is made on this week’s chart. This is the Billboard Hot 100 top 10 for the week dated Sept. 26. “Be Her” slips to 10, as does “Man I Need” to nine, and “So Easy” to No. 8. Karol G jumps to seven, with Taylor Swift falling to six. “Dracula” is up a spot, while Ariana is down to four. “Been By Now” climbs to three. “Boston” is locked at No. 2. So becoming the longest running No. 1 of all time with 23 weeks is Ella Langley’s “Choosin’ Texas.”
